title: The App That Toppled a President
description: How Paraguay's digital bank Ueno collapsed, froze millions of accounts, and triggered the impeachment of President Santiago Peña.

characters.name: Everyman
characters.look: 30s, brown hair, simple blue shirt, khaki pants, holding a coffee cup
characters.voice: Male, 30s, neutral American accent, mid pitch, clear timbre, steady pace, grounded energy

characters.name: Mayor Santos
characters.look: 50s, graying hair in a bun, green vest over white blouse, gold key necklace
characters.voice: Female, 50s, slight South American lilt, low pitch, warm timbre, deliberate pace, authoritative energy

characters.name: Tech Boss Leo
characters.look: 40s, slicked-back black hair, oversized glasses, sleek black turtleneck and jeans, holding a tablet
characters.voice: Male, 40s, crisp British accent, high pitch, bright timbre, fast pace, enthusiastic energy

characters.name: Investigator Rivera
characters.look: 60s, weathered face, short beard, orange safety vest over plaid shirt, holding a clipboard
characters.voice: Male, 60s, deep gravelly tone, no specific accent, low pitch, rough timbre, slow pace, serious energy

environments.ambience: Soft synth hum and rapid typing sounds

environments.ambience: Distant clock ticking and occasional phone rings

scenes.hero_prompt: A sleek smartphone screen fractures into thousands of frozen digital coins and banknotes floating in mid-air above a city skyline.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What happens when *three million* people lose their life savings overnight?

scenes.narration: What happens when *three million* people lose their life savings overnight?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet Ueno, a homegrown digital bank that became deeply embedded in Paraguay's payments system.

scenes.narration: Meet Ueno, a homegrown digital bank that became deeply embedded in Paraguay's payments system.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: So this app just *won over* half the country?

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: Exactly! It offered a sleek interface for those underserved by brick-and-mortar banks.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Until it didn't?

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: Until regulators stepped in. The solvency ratio fell below half the *legal minimum*.

scenes.narration: So this app just *won over* half the country? Exactly! It offered a sleek interface for those underserved by brick-and-mortar banks. Until it didn't? Until regulators stepped in. The solvency ratio fell below half the *legal minimum*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Reuters reported around $850 million in public funds administered by the lender.

scenes.narration: Reuters reported around $850 million in public funds administered by the lender.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: We just shifted to a *resolution process* on November 3rd.

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: Which means your mobile app, cards, and transfers are completely frozen right now.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: But the Central Bank inspectors found poorly documented loans to *connected companies*!

scenes.narration: We just shifted to a *resolution process* on November 3rd. Which means your mobile app, cards, and transfers are completely frozen right now. But the Central Bank inspectors found poorly documented loans to *connected companies*!

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Wait, can people just *get their money back*?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: Deposit insurance covers up to roughly $35,000 per customer.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Does that mean everyone is safe?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: It covers the full balances of an estimated 97 percent. The rest are waiting.

scenes.narration: Wait, can people just *get their money back*? Deposit insurance covers up to roughly $35,000 per customer. Does that mean everyone is safe? It covers the full balances of an estimated 97 percent. The rest are waiting.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When branches closed and apps stopped working, a rush to open accounts elsewhere disrupted other banks' systems.

scenes.narration: When branches closed and apps stopped working, a rush to open accounts elsewhere disrupted other banks' systems.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Demonstrators marched through Asunción demanding their savings and accountability from the government.

scenes.narration: Demonstrators marched through Asunción demanding their savings and accountability from the government.

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: The lower house voted 78 in favor of impeachment on November 5th.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: But President Peña submitted his resignation a day earlier! Why push forward?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Because the Senate proceeded with the trial. The vote was 44 to zero.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: A unanimous removal? That's a *political landslide*!

scenes.narration: The lower house voted 78 in favor of impeachment on November 5th. But President Peña submitted his resignation a day earlier! Why push forward? Because the Senate proceeded with the trial. The vote was 44 to zero. A unanimous removal? That's a *political landslide*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lawmakers accused Peña's government of allowing $355 million from the state pension fund to be deposited beyond legal limits.

scenes.narration: Lawmakers accused Peña's government of allowing $355 million from the state pension fund to be deposited beyond legal limits.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: So does the resignation *save* his legal standing?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Under Article 189, resignation would grant a lifetime Senate seat and immunity.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: And because they impeached him instead?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Precisely. He was stripped of protections and placed under *house arrest* on November 6th.

scenes.narration: So does the resignation *save* his legal standing? Under Article 189, resignation would grant a lifetime Senate seat and immunity. And because they impeached him instead? Precisely. He was stripped of protections and placed under *house arrest* on November 6th.

scenes.hero_prompt: A heavy gavel strikes down next to a pair of handcuffs resting on a blurred government document, cast in dramatic shadows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Prosecutors charged him with breach of trust and administration for personal gain the very next day.

scenes.narration: Prosecutors charged him with breach of trust and administration for personal gain the very next day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Peña's attorney argued that ousting a president during a bank resolution could destabilize the financial system.

scenes.narration: Peña's attorney argued that ousting a president during a bank resolution could destabilize the financial system.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Did his own party *abandon* him?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: Former president Horacio Cartes withdrew support, calling it the plundering of pensioners' money.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: So he's completely alone?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: He sent lawyers to the Senate but refused to attend himself. A *political isolation*.

scenes.narration: Did his own party *abandon* him? Former president Horacio Cartes withdrew support, calling it the plundering of pensioners' money. So he's completely alone? He sent lawyers to the Senate but refused to attend himself. A *political isolation*.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: What about Carlos Carvallo? He led the central bank after all.

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: He was also charged with breach of trust and producing false documents. Pretrial detention approved.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: So both the president and the regulator are *down*?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Investigators are examining whether officials failed to act on warning signs.

scenes.narration: What about Carlos Carvallo? He led the central bank after all. He was also charged with breach of trust and producing false documents. Pretrial detention approved. So both the president and the regulator are *down*? Investigators are examining whether officials failed to act on warning signs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A judge ordered Peña held at a military facility, marking the second Paraguayan president removed via impeachment since 1989.

scenes.narration: A judge ordered Peña held at a military facility, marking the second Paraguayan president removed via impeachment since 1989.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Who takes over *now*?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: Vice-President Pedro Alliana was sworn in to complete the term until August 2028.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Is he safe from scrutiny?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: He is also under investigation in connection with the bank. *Political uncertainty* remains.

scenes.narration: Who takes over *now*? Vice-President Pedro Alliana was sworn in to complete the term until August 2028. Is he safe from scrutiny? He is also under investigation in connection with the bank. *Political uncertainty* remains.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Central Bank estimates the guarantee covers around 97 percent of Ueno's customers.

scenes.narration: The Central Bank estimates the guarantee covers around 97 percent of Ueno's customers.

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Authorities have promised that depositors will be reimbursed entirely.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: How much has been returned so far?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: The equivalent of $160 million paid out to nearly 1.2 million savers.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: That's progress, but analysts warn the *damage to reputation* may linger.

scenes.narration: Authorities have promised that depositors will be reimbursed entirely. How much has been returned so far? The equivalent of $160 million paid out to nearly 1.2 million savers. That's progress, but analysts warn the *damage to reputation* may linger.

scenes.hero_prompt: A cracked mirror reflecting a fractured smartphone, surrounded by floating golden coins slipping through invisible fingers.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the moment when Paraguay must demonstrate that its institutions are functioning.

scenes.narration: This is the moment when Paraguay must demonstrate that its institutions are functioning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Peña denied wrongdoing, while a state electricity worker called the crisis an enormous betrayal of trust.

scenes.narration: Peña denied wrongdoing, while a state electricity worker called the crisis an enormous betrayal of trust.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: How do people even *describe* this mess?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: An economist called it a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde. They didn't rob us with a pistol.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: They robbed us with an app? Seriously?

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: Exactly. A sleek app, a hidden shortfall, and a political domino effect.

scenes.narration: How do people even *describe* this mess? An economist called it a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde. They didn't rob us with a pistol. They robbed us with an app? Seriously? Exactly. A sleek app, a hidden shortfall, and a political domino effect.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: So no more *lifetime senate seats* for failed presidents?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Impeachment strips that protection. Democracy isn't a revolving door.

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: I guess keeping your accounts *safe* matters more than political perks?

lines.speaker: investigator_rivera
lines.text: Without public funds, the whole system collapses. It really does.

scenes.narration: So no more *lifetime senate seats* for failed presidents? Impeachment strips that protection. Democracy isn't a revolving door. I guess keeping your accounts *safe* matters more than political perks? Without public funds, the whole system collapses. It really does.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: Next time I'll just stick to *physical branches* and paper receipts.

lines.speaker: mayor_santos
lines.text: Better yet, check your solvency ratios before you go viral.

lines.speaker: tech_boss_leo
lines.text: Don't worry, my app is perfectly regulated. I swear on my *coffee machine*!

scenes.narration: Next time I'll just stick to *physical branches* and paper receipts. Better yet, check your solvency ratios before you go viral. Don't worry, my app is perfectly regulated. I swear on my *coffee machine*!

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: That's the story of how a banking glitch toppled a government. Thanks for watching!

lines.speaker: every_man
lines.text: Like and subscribe before I check my own bank account in panic.
